chunks: He said: 'It is my staff, I lean on it, and I beat the leaves for my goats with it, and I have other uses for it.'
ai.seo_question: What were the practical uses of Prophet Musa's staff according to the Quranic narrative?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Musa (AS) modestly describes his staff as a humble tool for daily pastoral life—supporting his walk and beating foliage for his flock—before God reveals its latent miraculous power. Shia scholars emphasize this narrative as a lesson in humility, illustrating how divine authority often elevates simple, everyday objects into instruments of great sign (ayah) when commanded by God. This context underscores the transition from the mundane to the miraculous, a key theme in the story of Musa.
